advantages.name: 360° Vision
advantages.description: Full field of vision. No penalties from rear/side attacks; +5 to spot shadowing.

advantages.name: Absolute Direction
advantages.description: Knows north at all times; +3 to Navigation. 3D Spatial Sense [10] adds 3D navigation and Piloting/Free Fall bonuses.

advantages.name: Absolute Timing
advantages.description: Precise internal clock. Chronolocation [5] grants exact temporal awareness across time travel.

advantages.name: Acute Senses
advantages.description: +1 per level to Sense rolls for a specific sense (Hearing, Sight, Touch, Taste/Smell).

advantages.name: Affliction
advantages.description: Ranged attack that inflicts conditions (stunning, agony, paralysis, attribute penalties) instead of physical damage.

advantages.name: Allies
advantages.description: Loyal NPC companions. Cost varies based on power level (25% to 150%+ of PC points) and frequency of appearance (x1/2 to x4).

advantages.name: Altered Time Rate
advantages.description: Subjective time speedup. Grants one extra combat maneuver/action per turn per level.

advantages.name: Alternate Identity
advantages.description: Documentation and biometric registration under a false identity. Legal = 5 pts; Illegal = 15 pts.

advantages.name: Ambidexterity
advantages.description: Eliminates the -4 DX penalty for using the off hand.

advantages.name: Amphibious
advantages.description: Normal movement speed in water; no skill penalties underwater.

advantages.name: Animal Empathy
advantages.description: Reads animal motivations and emotions via IQ roll; allows Influence skills on beasts.

advantages.name: Arm DX
advantages.description: Extra DX applying specifically to fine manual tasks with one (12 pts) or two (16 pts) arms.

advantages.name: Arm ST
advantages.description: Extra Strength applying specifically to arm lifting and attacks (1 arm = 3 pts; 2 arms = 5 pts; 3 arms = 8 pts).

advantages.name: Binding
advantages.description: Ranged attack that grapples and roots targets in place with a ST equal to Binding level.

advantages.name: Blessed
advantages.description: Divine attunement. Blessed [10] grants wisdom/omens from a deity; Heroic Feats [10] adds +1d to ST, DX, or HT temporarily once per session.

advantages.name: Brachiator
advantages.description: +2 to Climbing; moves at half Basic Move swinging through trees/ropes.

advantages.name: Breath-Holding
advantages.description: Doubles breath-holding duration per level.

advantages.name: Catfall
advantages.description: Automatically subtracts 5 yards from fall distance; DX roll halves remaining fall damage.

advantages.name: Chameleon
advantages.description: Color-matching skin. +2 per level to Stealth when motionless (+1 per level when moving).

advantages.name: Channeling
advantages.description: Enters a trance to allow spirits to communicate through the character's body.

advantages.name: Charisma
advantages.description: Natural magnetic personality. +1 per level to reaction rolls and social Influence skills.

advantages.name: Claim to Hospitality
advantages.description: Right to lodging and basic aid from a social group, guild, or extended family network.

advantages.name: Clairsentience
advantages.description: Displaces senses to a viewpoint up to 10 yards away.

advantages.name: Claws
advantages.description: Natural weapons. Blunt Claws [3] (+1 punch/kick dmg); Hooves [3] (+1 kick dmg); Sharp Claws [5] (Cutting dmg); Talons [8] (Cutting/Impaling); Long Talons [11] (+1 dmg/die Cutting/Impaling).

advantages.name: Clerical Investment
advantages.description: Ordained religious status. Grants Religious Rank 0 and +1 reaction bonus from believers.

advantages.name: Clinging
advantages.description: Ability to walk on vertical walls and ceilings at half Basic Move.

advantages.name: Combat Reflexes
advantages.description: +1 to active defenses (Block, Dodge, Parry), +1 to Fast-Draw, +2 to Fright Checks; immune to surprise freezing; +6 to recover from mental stun.

advantages.name: Common Sense
advantages.description: GM rolls against IQ to warn the player before doing something foolish.

advantages.name: Compartmentalized Mind
advantages.description: Multiple independent mental compartments, enabling simultaneous mental maneuvers and spellcasting.

advantages.name: Constriction Attack
advantages.description: Crushes grappled targets via a Quick Contest of ST vs. victim's ST or HT.

advantages.name: Contacts / Contact Group
advantages.description: Associates providing specialized information or minor favors. Cost based on effective skill (12 to 21), frequency, and reliability.

advantages.name: Cultural Adaptability
advantages.description: Completely eliminates cultural unfamiliarity penalties for human cultures [10] or all alien cultures [20].

advantages.name: Damage Resistance (DR)
advantages.description: Natural armor subtracting directly from incoming attack damage.

advantages.name: Danger Sense
advantages.description: GM secretly rolls Per to grant advance warning of impending traps, ambushes, or danger.

advantages.name: Daredevil
advantages.description: +1 to all skill rolls and rerolls critical failures when taking extreme, high-risk actions.

advantages.name: Dark Vision
advantages.description: Complete vision in absolute darkness without penalties (monochrome).

advantages.name: Destiny
advantages.description: Preordained positive fate guiding the character's life (Minor = 5 pts; Major = 10 pts; Great = 15 pts).

advantages.name: Detect
advantages.description: Sensory ability to detect specific substances, energy, or phenomena.

advantages.name: Digital Mind
advantages.description: Computer program consciousness; immune to telepathy and biological mind-control, but vulnerable to viruses and hacking.

advantages.name: Discriminatory Hearing
advantages.description: Voice and sound signature identification; +4 to hearing tasks and shadowing noisy targets.

advantages.name: Discriminatory Smell
advantages.description: Recognizes distinct scent profiles; +4 to smell tasks and Tracking.

advantages.name: Discriminatory Taste
advantages.description: Detailed chemical analysis of ingested substances via taste.

advantages.name: Doesn't Breathe
advantages.description: Complete oxygen independence; immune to suffocation, choking, and gas toxins.

advantages.name: Doesn't Eat or Drink
advantages.description: Does not require food or water for survival.

advantages.name: Doesn't Sleep
advantages.description: Fully operational 24/7 without needing rest.

advantages.name: Dominance
advantages.description: Infects targets with a supernatural condition (vampirism/lycanthropy) to turn them into loyal subordinates.

advantages.name: Duplication
advantages.description: Splits into multiple identical physical copies sharing HP/FP reserves.

advantages.name: Eidetic Memory
advantages.description: Superior recall. Eidetic [5] remembers general facts; Photographic [10] grants exact visual/auditory recall.

advantages.name: Elastic Skin
advantages.description: Alters facial features and skin texture; +4 to Disguise rolls.

advantages.name: Empathy
advantages.description: Detects emotional states and lies. Sensitive [5] (IQ-3 roll); Empathy [15] (full IQ roll, +3 to Detect Lies).

advantages.name: Enhanced Defenses
advantages.description: +1 bonus to active defenses: Enhanced Block [5], Enhanced Parry [5 or 10], Enhanced Dodge [15].

advantages.name: Enhanced Move
advantages.description: Doubles top movement speed in a specific environment (Air, Ground, Water, Space) per level.

advantages.name: Enhanced Time Sense
advantages.description: High-speed mental perception; includes Combat Reflexes and initiative priority.

advantages.name: Enhanced Tracking
advantages.description: Enables Aim/Evaluate maneuvers on multiple targets simultaneously.

advantages.name: Extended Lifespan
advantages.description: Doubles the age threshold for aging rolls per level.

advantages.name: Extra Arms
advantages.description: Additional functional manipulative limbs.

advantages.name: Extra Attack
advantages.description: Grants an additional attack maneuver per turn in combat.

advantages.name: Extra Head
advantages.description: Additional head with extra eyes/ears, backup brain, and Extra Mouth.

advantages.name: Extra Legs
advantages.description: Additional non-manipulative legs (3–4 legs = 5 pts; 5–6 legs = 10 pts; 7+ legs = 15 pts).

advantages.name: Extra Life
advantages.description: Allows a character to survive death through luck, divine intervention, or backup restoration.

advantages.name: Extra Mouth
advantages.description: Additional functional mouth for eating, biting, or speaking.

advantages.name: Fearlessness
advantages.description: +1 per level to Will rolls against Fright Checks and Intimidation.

advantages.name: Filter Lungs
advantages.description: Filters environmental smoke, dust, and non-contact gas toxins.

advantages.name: Fit / Very Fit
advantages.description: Superior cardiovascular health. Fit [5] (+1 HT rolls, 2x FP recovery); Very Fit [15] (+2 HT rolls, half FP loss).

advantages.name: Flexibility / Double-Jointed
advantages.description: Exceptional body flexibility. +3 [5] or +5 [15] to Climbing, Escape, and grapple recovery.

advantages.name: Flight
advantages.description: Self-powered atmospheric flight at Basic Speed x 2.

advantages.name: Gadgeteer
advantages.description: Inventive genius. Standard [25] creates advanced gear; Quick Gadgeteer [50] builds working inventions in minutes.

advantages.name: G-Experience
advantages.description: Eliminates DX penalties in specific non-native gravity fields (1 pt/field or 10 pts for All).

advantages.name: Gizmos
advantages.description: Pulls out a small, previously unspecified piece of required gear on the spot (max 3/session).

advantages.name: Growth
advantages.description: Increases Size Modifier by +1 per level, expanding height and scale.

advantages.name: Gunslinger
advantages.description: Cinematic firearm mastery; grants instant Acc bonuses and eliminates stunt/movement penalties.

advantages.name: Hard to Kill
advantages.description: +1 per level to HT survival rolls at negative Hit Points.

advantages.name: Hard to Subdue
advantages.description: +1 per level to HT rolls to avoid unconsciousness or knockout.

advantages.name: Healing
advantages.description: Restores HP (1 FP per 2 HP healed) or cures diseases in others via physical contact and an IQ roll.

advantages.name: Hermaphromorph
advantages.description: Switches physical gender between male, female, and neuter forms.

advantages.name: High Manual Dexterity
advantages.description: +1 per level to fine motor DX skills (Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Surgery, etc.).

advantages.name: High Pain Threshold
advantages.description: Completely ignores shock penalties from injuries; +3 to resist torture, stunning, and knockdown.

advantages.name: Higher Purpose
advantages.description: +1 to all rolls directly pursuing a specific, noble cause or moral duty.

advantages.name: Hyperspectral Vision
advantages.description: Full-spectrum vision (Infrared, Visible, Ultraviolet); grants perfect night vision and +3 Vision rolls.

advantages.name: Illuminated
advantages.description: Intuitive awareness of secret global conspiracies and supernatural puppet masters.

advantages.name: Improved G-Tolerance
advantages.description: Increases the gravity threshold bracket before suffering physical penalties.

advantages.name: Indomitable
advantages.description: Immune to ordinary social Influence skills unless the attacker has specialized Empathy traits.

advantages.name: Infravision
advantages.description: Sees heat signatures in darkness; +2 to spot living targets (0 pts if permanent/only vision, 10 pts if switchable).

advantages.name: Injury Tolerance
advantages.description: Physiological resilience. Includes No Blood [5], No Brain [5], No Eyes [5], No Neck [5], No Vitals [5], Unliving [20], Homogenous [40], and Diffuse [100].

advantages.name: Innate Attack
advantages.description: Built-in physical, elemental, or energy attack doing custom damage (Burning = 5/die, Crushing = 5/die, Cutting = 7/die, Impaling = 8/die, Toxic = 4/die, Corrosion = 10/die, Fatigue = 10/die).

advantages.name: Insubstantiality
advantages.description: Intangible ghost-like state; moves through solid walls and ignores physical attacks.

advantages.name: Intuition
advantages.description: GM rolls IQ to guide the character toward correct choices when facing blind decisions.

advantages.name: Invisibility
advantages.description: Unseen by light/visual spectrums; grants +9 to Stealth against visual detection.

advantages.name: Jumper
advantages.description: Teleports across time (Time) or between parallel dimensions (World) via an IQ roll.

advantages.name: Language Talent
advantages.description: Reduces character point costs for acquiring foreign language fluency.

advantages.name: Legal Enforcement Powers
advantages.description: Law enforcement arrest, search, and lethal force authority.

advantages.name: Legal Immunity
advantages.description: Exemption from local laws and prosecution (e.g., Diplomatic Immunity = 20 pts).

advantages.name: Less Sleep
advantages.description: Reduces daily required sleep time by 1 hour per level (max 4 levels).

advantages.name: Lifting ST
advantages.description: Increases lifting capacity and grappling strength without altering base Hit Points or melee damage.

advantages.name: Lightning Calculator
advantages.description: Instant mental math calculations. Intuitive Mathematician [5] solves complex astrophysics/engineering equations mentally.

advantages.name: Longevity
advantages.description: Automatically succeeds on aging rolls except on a critical failure (17 or 18).

advantages.name: Luck
advantages.description: Rerolls bad dice rolls twice and takes the best result once per hour [15], 30 min [30], or 10 min [60].

advantages.name: Magery
advantages.description: Magical attunement. Magery 0 [5] senses magical items; higher levels add directly to IQ when casting/learning spells.

advantages.name: Magic Resistance
advantages.description: Subtracts level from hostile spell rolls and adds to resistance rolls against magic. Prevents spellcasting.

advantages.name: Mana Damper
advantages.description: Reduces local magical energy level in the character's immediate vicinity.

advantages.name: Mana Enhancer
advantages.description: Radiates an aura that increases local mana density by one step per level.

advantages.name: Medium
advantages.description: Perceives and communicates with spirits of the deceased.

advantages.name: Metabolism Control
advantages.description: Controls bodily processes; +1/level to bleeding/poison rolls and enters feigned death trances.

advantages.name: Microscopic Vision
advantages.description: Magnifies objects within 1 foot by 10x per level (10x, 100x, 1,000x, etc.).

advantages.name: Mimicry
advantages.description: Imitates voices, animal calls, and environmental sounds after hearing them.

advantages.name: Mind Control
advantages.description: Dominate another's mind via a Quick Contest of IQ vs. subject's Will.

advantages.name: Mind Probe
advantages.description: Deep mental interrogation; extracts secret memories and precise answers to questions.

advantages.name: Mind Reading
advantages.description: Reads surface thoughts and sensory inputs via a Quick Contest of IQ vs. Will.

advantages.name: Mind Shield
advantages.description: Mental defense against telepathy, mind control, and intrusion spells.

advantages.name: Mindlink
advantages.description: Permanent, effortless telepathic link with specified individuals.

advantages.name: Modular Abilities
advantages.description: Reallocatable point pool to swap mental abilities, skills, or spells on the fly.

advantages.name: Neutralize
advantages.description: Nullifies an opponent's psionic or exotic powers through physical contact.

advantages.name: Nictitating Membrane
advantages.description: Transparent inner eyelid providing eye DR 1 per level and protection from eye irritants.

advantages.name: Night Vision
advantages.description: Eliminates -1 in darkness penalties per level (up to -9).

advantages.name: Obscure
advantages.description: Actively jams or blocks a specific sense within a 2-yard radius by -1 per level.

advantages.name: Oracle
advantages.description: Interprets natural omens and signs to discern future events.

advantages.name: Parabolic Hearing
advantages.description: Doubles hearing distance for targeted sounds per level.

advantages.name: Patrons
advantages.description: Powerful NPC mentor, noble lord, corporation, or government providing backing and assistance.

advantages.name: Payload
advantages.description: Internal body storage capacity for cargo or passengers (BL / 10 lbs per level).

advantages.name: Penetrating Vision
advantages.description: X-ray vision; sees through up to 6 inches of solid matter per level.

advantages.name: Perfect Balance
advantages.description: Complete stability; automatically walks ledges/tightropes; +1 Acrobatics/Climbing, +4 vs. knockdowns.

advantages.name: Peripheral Vision
advantages.description: Expands visual arc to 240°; defends against rear attacks at only -2.

advantages.name: Permeation
advantages.description: Passes through solid matter (earth, stone, metal, wood) as if it were air.

perks.name: Alcohol Tolerance
perks.description: +2 on HT rolls to resist drunkenness.

perks.name: Autofocus
perks.description: Built-in optical adjustment for rapid focus.

perks.name: Deep Sleeper
perks.description: Falls asleep easily anywhere; ignores noise penalties when sleeping.

perks.name: Honest Face
perks.description: Looks naturally innocent; +1 to Acting to claim innocence.

perks.name: No Hangover
perks.description: Never suffers negative side effects from drinking.

perks.name: Penetrating Voice
perks.description: +2 to be heard over loud noise or crowds.

perks.name: High-Limb Status
perks.description: Minor anatomical adaptations (e.g., prehensile tail tip).

disadvantages.name: Absent-Mindedness
disadvantages.description: Severe distraction; -5 to IQ rolls for everyday tasks and short-term memory recall.

disadvantages.name: Acrophobia (Heights)
disadvantages.description: Irrational terror of high places; requires Fright Check when elevated.

disadvantages.name: Addiction
disadvantages.description: Compulsory substance dependence. Value depends on cost, legality, and physical effect.

disadvantages.name: Alcoholism
disadvantages.description: Severe addiction to alcohol; requires daily self-control rolls to avoid drinking.

disadvantages.name: Amnesia
disadvantages.description: Partial [-10] or total [-25] memory loss. Total amnesia hides the character sheet from the player.

disadvantages.name: Appearance (Below Average)
disadvantages.description: Unattractive (-4, -1 reaction); Ugly (-8, -2 reaction); Hideous (-16, -4 reaction); Monstrous (-20, -5 reaction); Horrific (-24, -6 reaction).

disadvantages.name: Aquaphobia (Water)
disadvantages.description: Panic and inability to act voluntarily around deep water.

disadvantages.name: Bad Back
disadvantages.description: Fragile spine; severe pain and knockdowns on heavy exertion or throwing.

disadvantages.name: Bad Bite
disadvantages.description: Misaligned jaw; cannot deliver biting damage or use certain oral abilities.

disadvantages.name: Bad Sight
disadvantages.description: Nearsighted or Farsighted. -6 to vision rolls without glasses; correctable via glasses (worth -10 pts if uncorrectable).

disadvantages.name: Bad Temper
disadvantages.description: Must roll self-control (CR 12) whenever insulted or frustrated, or fly into a rage.

disadvantages.name: Berserk
disadvantages.description: In combat or severe stress, loses all self-control, attacking nearest targets relentlessly without active defenses.

disadvantages.name: Bleeder
disadvantages.description: Hemophilia; wound bleeding does not stop naturally and inflicts double injury over time.

disadvantages.name: Blindness
disadvantages.description: Complete loss of vision; -10 to combat actions and reliance on non-visual senses.

disadvantages.name: Bloodlust
disadvantages.description: Must attempt to kill every defeated enemy; requires self-control roll to accept surrenders or take prisoners.

disadvantages.name: Callous
disadvantages.description: Lacks empathy; -2 to Teaching, Psychology, and social interaction skills requiring emotion.

disadvantages.name: Charity
disadvantages.description: Compulsive need to give away money and aid to anyone in need.

disadvantages.name: Chivalry (Code of Honor)
disadvantages.description: Moral obligation to protect women, never attack an unarmed foe, and honor promises.

disadvantages.name: Chronic Pain
disadvantages.description: Periodic crippling pain inflicting severe skill penalties.

disadvantages.name: Clueless
disadvantages.description: Completely fails to understand social nuances; -4 to Savoir-Faire, Fast-Talk, and Streetwise.

disadvantages.name: Code of Honor
disadvantages.description: Self-imposed binding rules of conduct (Pirate's = -5, Gentleman's = -10, Chivalry = -15, Soldier's = -10).

disadvantages.name: Combative
disadvantages.description: Eager to pick fights and settle disagreements through physical force.

disadvantages.name: Compulsive Carousing
disadvantages.description: Cannot resist social drinking, partying, and nightlife whenever available.

disadvantages.name: Compulsive Gambling
disadvantages.description: Compulsive urge to gamble money on any chance event.

disadvantages.name: Compulsive Generosity
disadvantages.description: Uncontrolled urge to give gifts and financial support.

disadvantages.name: Compulsive Lying
disadvantages.description: Cannot tell the truth even when lying is foolish or harmful.

disadvantages.name: Compulsive Spending
disadvantages.description: Uncontrolled urge to buy unnecessary items regardless of financial standing.

disadvantages.name: Compulsive Vow
disadvantages.description: Fanatical commitment to a specific quest or self-imposed duty.

disadvantages.name: Confused
disadvantages.description: Difficulty making decisions under stress; -2 to IQ rolls in high-pressure situations.

disadvantages.name: Cowardice
disadvantages.description: Terrified of personal physical danger; requires self-control roll to face combat or risk.

disadvantages.name: Curious
disadvantages.description: Cannot resist investigating unusual mysteries, closed doors, or strange phenomena.

disadvantages.name: Deafness
disadvantages.description: Complete inability to hear; immune to sound attacks, but relies on sign language or lip reading.

disadvantages.name: Delusions
disadvantages.description: False beliefs about reality (Minor = -5, Major = -10, Severe = -15).

disadvantages.name: Dependents
disadvantages.description: Non-combatant loved ones or children who require protection (cost varies by power level and appearance).

disadvantages.name: Duty
disadvantages.description: Mandatory service obligation to an employer, military order, or government.

disadvantages.name: Dwarfism
disadvantages.description: Abnormally short stature (-1 Size Modifier); -1 Basic Move and reduced combat reach.

disadvantages.name: Dyslexia
disadvantages.description: Inability to read or interpret written symbols.

disadvantages.name: Easy to Read
disadvantages.description: Facial expressions reveal true thoughts; +4 to others' Detect Lies and Psychology rolls against the character.

disadvantages.name: Enemies
disadvantages.description: Hostile individuals or organizations actively trying to harm or kill the character.

disadvantages.name: Fanaticism
disadvantages.description: Total devotion to a cause, nation, or religion above all personal safety and morals.

disadvantages.name: Fat
disadvantages.description: Weight is 150% of normal; -2 to Disguise/Shadowing; +3 Swimming, +2 vs. knockback.

disadvantages.name: Flashbacks
disadvantages.description: Traumatic past memories triggered under stress, causing temporary disorientation.

disadvantages.name: Gullible
disadvantages.description: Believes almost anything told; -3 to resist Fast-Talk, Lies, and deception.

disadvantages.name: Hard of Hearing
disadvantages.description: -4 to all Hearing rolls.

disadvantages.name: Hemophobia (Blood)
disadvantages.description: Panic and nausea upon seeing blood or severe injuries.

disadvantages.name: Honesty
disadvantages.description: Must obey local laws strictly, even inconvenient ones, unless resisting via self-control roll.

disadvantages.name: Impulsiveness
disadvantages.description: Acts before thinking; cannot sit passively and plan when action is possible.

disadvantages.name: Incurious
disadvantages.description: Completely lacks interest in new things or surrounding events.

disadvantages.name: Indecisive
disadvantages.description: Paralyzed by choices in crisis situations; requires self-control roll to take initiative.

disadvantages.name: Intolerance
disadvantages.description: Unreasonable prejudice against a specific group (-5) or all foreign groups (-10).

disadvantages.name: Jealousy
disadvantages.description: Resents anyone smarter, richer, or more successful.

disadvantages.name: Killjoy
disadvantages.description: Inability to experience joy or pleasure; immune to carousing and social allurements.

disadvantages.name: Lame
disadvantages.description: Crippled limbs or mobility impairment (Crippled Leg = -10, One Leg = -20, Legless = -30).

disadvantages.name: Laziness
disadvantages.description: Avoids physical or mental effort; -58% to job performance and study effort.

disadvantages.name: Lecherousness
disadvantages.description: Compulsive attraction to attractive members of the opposite sex.

disadvantages.name: Low TL
disadvantages.description: Familiarity with a tech level below campaign average.

disadvantages.name: Miserliness
disadvantages.description: Hoards money; refuses to spend cash on anything non-essential.

disadvantages.name: Mute
disadvantages.description: Complete inability to produce vocal speech.

disadvantages.name: Night Blindness
disadvantages.description: Double vision penalties in dim light or darkness.

disadvantages.name: Oblivious
disadvantages.description: Completely unaware of social cues; -2 to social skills.

disadvantages.name: Odious Personal Habits (OPH)
disadvantages.description: Repugnant behavior giving -1, -2, or -3 on social reaction rolls.

disadvantages.name: One Arm
disadvantages.description: Missing one functional arm/hand.

disadvantages.name: One Eye
disadvantages.description: Missing one eye; -1 to DX combat rolls and -3 to ranged attacks.

disadvantages.name: Overconfidence
disadvantages.description: Overestimates personal capabilities; believes they can handle any challenge easily.

disadvantages.name: Overweight
disadvantages.description: Weight is 130% of normal; -1 to Disguise; +1 Swimming, +1 vs. knockback.

disadvantages.name: Pacifism
disadvantages.description: Moral opposition to violence (Reluctant Killer = -5, Self-Defense Only = -15, Cannot Kill = -15, Total Nonviolence = -30).

disadvantages.name: Paranoia
disadvantages.description: Constant distrust of everyone; believes everyone is plotting against them.

disadvantages.name: Phobias
disadvantages.description: Irrational terror of specific objects, creatures, or situations (e.g., Spiders, Darkness, Enclosed Spaces).

disadvantages.name: Pyromania
disadvantages.description: Compulsive urge to set fires.

disadvantages.name: Secret
disadvantages.description: Hidden past crime or identity that would ruin or kill the character if revealed.

disadvantages.name: Sense of Duty
disadvantages.description: Selfless devotion to protect specific groups (Companions = -5, Nation = -10, Humanity = -20).

disadvantages.name: Skinny
disadvantages.description: Weight is 2/3 average; -2 to ST knockback resistance and -2 to Disguise.

disadvantages.name: Social Stigma
disadvantages.description: Second-class legal or social status (Minor = -5, Criminal Record = -5, Subjugated = -20).

disadvantages.name: Stuttering
disadvantages.description: Speech impediment; -2 to speech-dependent skills and communication.

disadvantages.name: Truthfulness
disadvantages.description: Dislikes lying; must make self-control roll to tell a lie.

disadvantages.name: Unlucky
disadvantages.description: GM periodically inflicts bad luck or catastrophic timing once per session.

disadvantages.name: Very Fat
disadvantages.description: Weight is 200% of normal; -3 Disguise; +5 Swimming, +3 vs. knockback; max HT 13.

disadvantages.name: Workaholic
disadvantages.description: Compulsively works constantly; suffers stress and agitation when idle.

quirks.name: Attitude Quirk
quirks.description: Minor bias or personal dislike (e.g., 'Dislikes dogs').

quirks.name: Habitual Quirk
quirks.description: Minor unconscious habit (e.g., 'Always hums while working').

quirks.name: Preference Quirk
quirks.description: Distinctive cosmetic choice (e.g., 'Always wears black clothes').

quirks.name: Belief Quirk
quirks.description: Trivial non-game-affecting belief (e.g., 'Believes full moons bring good luck').

quirks.name: Physical Quirk
quirks.description: Trivial cosmetic feature (e.g., 'Unusual bright green eyes').
